Faber Romanus is one semantic core with many renderings. The pack keys are Latin spellings, which no living population claims; no human language is privileged. Pick the documentation language you read; the glyphs are the same in all of them.

Same program, every pack

One program, 7 renderings. The HIR is one; the rendering is the pack. Pick a tab to preview Faber in that reader locale — the panels are real pack source, not mock copy.

English · en · enter docs →
fn greet(string msg) → string {
  return msg
}

main {
  let _ greeting ← greet("Hello, World!")
  print greeting
}
ภาษาไทย · th-TH · enter docs →
ฟังก์ชัน salve(ข้อความ nomen) → ข้อความ {
    กำหนด ข้อความ msg ← "สวัสดี, §!"(nomen)
    คืน msg
}

เริ่ม {
    กำหนด ข้อความ m ← salve("โลก")
    แสดง m
}
العربية · ar · enter docs →
دالة salve(نص nomen) → نص {
    ليكن نص msg ← "مرحبا، §!"(nomen)
    أعد msg
}

بداية {
    ليكن نص m ← salve("عالم")
    اعرض m
}
हिन्दी · hi · enter docs →
फलन salve(पाठ nomen) → पाठ {
    बैठा पाठ msg ← "नमस्ते, §!"(nomen)
    लौटाओ msg
}

आरंभ {
    बैठा पाठ m ← salve("दुनिया")
    दिखाओ m
}
Tiếng Việt · vi · enter docs →
hàm salve(vănbản nomen) → vănbản {
    đặt vănbản msg ← "Xin chào, §!"(nomen)
    trả msg
}

bắtđầu {
    đặt vănbản m ← salve("thế giới")
    in m
}
简体中文 · zh-Hans · enter docs →
函数 salve(文本 nomen) → 文本 {
    设 文本 msg ← "你好，§!"(nomen)
    返回 msg
}

入口 {
    设 文本 m ← salve("世界")
    显示 m
}
繁體中文 · zh-Hant · enter docs →
函式 salve(文字 nomen) → 文字 {
    常數 文字 msg ← "你好，§!"(nomen)
    傳回 msg
}

入口 {
    常數 文字 m ← salve("世界")
    顯示 m
}
